terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to the University Finder System. By accessing or using this platform, you agree to be bound by the following Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the platform.

descriptionOfService.title: 1. Description of Service
descriptionOfService.body: The University Finder System is a platform designed to help users explore and discover universities based on their academic background, interests, and preferences. The platform includes an AI-powered recommendation system that provides university suggestions and informational responses through an interactive chat interface.

userAccounts.title: 2. User Accounts
userAccounts.body: To access certain features of the platform, users may be required to create an account. Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and for all activities that occur under their account.

userInformation.title: 3. User Information
userInformation.body: Users may provide personal and academic information including educational background, academic achievements, internship experience, project experience, and other relevant details. This information is used to generate personalized university recommendations.

aiRecommendations.title: 4. AI Recommendations
aiRecommendations.body: The platform uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) to provide recommendations and suggestions for universities. These recommendations are intended for informational purposes only and should not be considered official admission advice or guarantees of acceptance.

cvUploadAndParsing.title: 5. CV Upload and Parsing
cvUploadAndParsing.body: Users may upload their curriculum vitae (CV) for automated analysis. The system may extract relevant information such as education, skills, projects, and experience in order to populate the user's profile and improve recommendation accuracy.

acceptableUse.title: 6. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: Users agree not to misuse the platform. Prohibited activities include:

items.unauthorizedAccess: Attempting to gain unauthorized access to the system
items.maliciousContent: Uploading malicious files or harmful content
items.unlawfulUse: Using the platform for unlawful purposes
items.systemDisruption: Attempting to disrupt or damage the system

savedUniversities.title: 7. Saved Universities
savedUniversities.body: Users may save recommended universities as favorites for future reference. These saved items are stored within the user's account and can be managed through the user dashboard.

limitationOfLiability.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.body: The University Finder System is provided for educational and informational purposes. The platform does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or suitability of recommendations. The developers are not responsible for any decisions made based on the information provided by the system.

changesToService.title: 9. Changes to the Service
changesToService.body: The system developers may update or modify the platform and its features at any time without prior notice.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact the system administrators or development team.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how the University Finder System collects, uses, and protects user information when using the platform.

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.body: The system may collect the following information:

items.chat: Interactions with the AI chat system

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.body: The collected information is used to:

items.aiImprovement: Improve the accuracy of the AI recommendation system
items.profileManagement: Allow users to manage their profiles
items.cvParsing: Enable CV parsing and automatic profile population
items.platformImprovement: Improve the overall functionality of the platform

aiProcessing.title: 3. AI Processing
aiProcessing.body: Information provided by users, including profile data and uploaded CV documents, may be processed by Artificial Intelligence models to generate recommendations and suggestions. These models analyze user information to provide more relevant university options.

dataStorage.title: 4. Data Storage
dataStorage.body: User information is stored within the system database and is used solely for the operation of the University Finder System.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.body: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are implemented to protect user data from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

dataSharing.title: 6. Data Sharing
dataSharing.body: The University Finder System does not sell, trade, or rent users' personal information to third parties. Data is used only within the platform to provide services and recommendations.

userControl.title: 7. User Control
userControl.body: Users may update or modify their profile information through the account settings page. Users may also remove saved universities from their favorites list.

uploadedDocuments.title: 8. Uploaded Documents
uploadedDocuments.body: When a user uploads a CV, the document may be processed by the system to extract relevant information such as education, experience, and skills. This information may be added to the user's profile automatically.

changesToPolicy.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
changesToPolicy.body: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in system functionality or data practices.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact the system administrators.
